description: Find the 3 to 5 best dates in the coming weeks for one goal (start something, launch or share, rest, love and connection, decide, learn or write), each with the weekday and plain reasons from the real sky: new and full moons and the house they fall in for this person, the Moon's sign that day against their Sun, Moon, rising and Mercury, Mercury and Venus sign changes and retrogrades, and eclipses. Also 1 or 2 days to go slow, and a link to the free 2027 planner. Use when someone asks "what is the best day to start", "when should I launch", "a good time to rest", "best date for a first date" or "when should I start writing". Dates are searched in an ephemeris checked against the Swiss Ephemeris. Birth time and place are optional; without them houses count from the Sun sign and the result says so. Timing themes only, never a promise.

birth_place.description: Birthplace as city, region, country, e.g. Austin, Texas, United States. Gives coordinates (and the time zone if time_zone is left out).

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Leave out if unknown.

days.description: How many days to search, 7 to 120. Default 60.

from_date.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today (UTC).

goal.description: What the person wants the day for: start_something, launch_or_share, rest_and_reset, love_and_connection, decide_something or learn_or_write (writing, studying).

latitude.description: Birthplace latitude, if the city is not found. Optional.

longitude.description: Birthplace longitude (east positive), with latitude. Optional.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. America/Chicago. Work it out from the birthplace. Needed with a birth_time unless birth_place is in our list.

name: get_best_days
title: Best days for a goal
